profit_quality.assessment: Low to medium-low cash-profit quality for owner-earnback purposes. Parent profit has been volatile across 2022-2024 and 2024 operating cash flow was below disclosed capital expenditure. 2023 reported profit was helped by a HK$259.011m land resumption compensation gain. Main case uses HK$14.262m pre-haircut sustainable profit and applies a 0.35 haircut.
adjustments: Use 2022-2024 median parent net profit of HK$14.262m as the pre-haircut sustainable profit anchor.
Do not capitalize 2023 land resumption compensation gain of HK$259.011m into recurring profit.
Treat interest income, lease modification gains and asset disposal gains as lower-quality/non-operating support.
Apply 0.35 profit haircut because 2024 operating cash flow of HK$151.701m did not cover HK$174.737m capex and the business carries material inventory/receivable working capital.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2024 OCF HK$151.701m; 2024 capex HK$174.737m. 2023 OCF HK$293.758m but 2023 profit included one-off land resumption gain and working-capital release.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Manufacturing business with thin margins, volatile parent profit, high working-capital assets and recent capex exceeding operating cash flow.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Weak in 2024 after capex; two-year cash data do not justify a high conversion factor.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Use HK$120m maintenance capex reference versus HK$174.737m disclosed 2024 capex and HK$159.051m depreciation of PPE plus investment properties.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Inventories HK$784.735m, receivables HK$802.069m and payables HK$562.544m imply continuing cash tied in operations.

limitations: Cash and deposits are not split by listed parent, subsidiary, PRC, HK and Sri Lanka holding entity, so detachable cash uses a conservative group-cash haircut.
Only 2023-2024 cash-flow detail was extracted from the 2024 annual report; 2022 cash-flow/capex detail remains a gap.
The operating-cash reserve is estimated, not directly disclosed, because the annual report does not state minimum operating cash required.
